queer_characters.name: Carol Aird
queer_characters.notes: Central protagonist in a romantic and consummated relationship with Therese; portrayal praised for avoiding butch/sexy-lesbian stereotypes and depicting a woman with agency who chooses to live authentically.

queer_characters.name: Therese Belivet
queer_characters.notes: Aspiring photographer who forms and consummates a romantic relationship with Carol; framed as a strong woman in love, part of the acclaimed depiction of genuine connection between two women.

queer_characters.name: Abby Gerhard
queer_characters.notes: Described in the source as Carol's ex-lover, representing her past; a supporting figure rather than a fully developed arc.

contributor_notes: Source text confirms Carol and Therese as a lesbian couple and Abby as Carol's ex-lover; identities marked explicit-in-text accordingly. Source describes an ending with 'the possibility of their reunion' — hopeful but not definitively a happy ending, so happy-ending was not tagged. Trigger warnings for custody loss, criminalization, and surveillance are noted in the source but fall outside the available enum; only homophobia mapped cleanly. No creator/cast queer identities are stated in the source, so queer_creators left empty. Maintainer should verify subtitle/audio availability and any creator identities from other sources.
